summary: The University of Leeds EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Future Fluid Dynamics offers a four-year integrated MSc and PhD in fluid dynamics, with 12 funding places for 2027 entry. The open route is available to UK and overseas-rated students. Applications are due by Thursday 7 January 2027, and funding starts on 1 October 2027.
highlights: Four-year integrated MSc and PhD in fluid dynamics.
